message.content:
I don’t have real‑time market data, so I can’t give you the exact price of gold for today.  The most reliable way to get the current spot price is to check a reputable financial news site (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC), a commodities exchange (e.g., COMEX), or a trusted bullion dealer’s website.  Those sources update the price every few minutes during market hours.

If you’re looking for a quick reference, the spot price of gold is usually quoted in U.S. dollars per troy ounce.  As of the last published figure I have (which may be a few days old), it was roughly **$1,950–$2,000 per ounce**.  For the exact price today, please consult one of the live sources mentioned above.
message.reasoning: User asks: "What is the gold price today in USA?" We need to provide current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price per ounce. But we should clarify that we don't have real-time data. We can provide a general answer: as of last known data, gold price was around $X per ounce. But we need to be careful. We can say "I don't have real-time data, but you can check reliable sources." We can also provide a typical price. But we should not provide inaccurate data. So we should respond with a disclaimer.
